treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany and the Macedonian Government for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital, with Protocol (2006, as amended by Protocol of 2016)
eif_quote: Art. 31: (1) This Agreement shall enter into force on the day on which the Contracting Parties have notified each other that the domestic requirements for entry into force of this Agreement are met. ... (2) This Agreement shall be applied in both territories a) in the case of taxes withheld at source, in respect of amounts paid on or after the first day of January of the calendar year next following that in which the Agreement entered into force; | UJP table: Germany | 86/2007 | 29.11.2010 | 01.01.2011
source_title: Deutscher Bundestag Drucksache 17/1944 (Government bill with German and English authentic texts of the 2006 DBA and Protocol); 2016 amending protocol: Drucksache 18/11869

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the sovereign territory of the Contracting Party in which it arises and according to the laws of the state of that Contracting Party, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the sovereign territory of the other Contracting Party, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the sovereign territory of the Contracting Party in which it arises according to the laws of the state of that Contracting Party, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the sovereign territory of the other Contracting Party, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: none (no PPT clause in treaty; MLI not applicable: North Macedonia signed the MLI on 2020-01-29 but has not ratified it)

notes: Art. 11(3): interest to the Macedonian Government exempt in Germany; interest on loans covered by German export/investment guarantees or paid to the German Government, Bundesbank, KfW or DEG exempt in Macedonia. Art. 11(4): interest on credit sales of industrial/commercial/scientific equipment or of goods between enterprises taxable only in residence State (not modelled). Protocol para. 3: dividends and interest from profit-participating rights (silent partnerships, partiarische Darlehen, Gewinnobligationen) deductible for the debtor may be taxed at source under domestic law without treaty limit. Protocol para. 2(c): technical service fees fall under Arts. 7/14. The 2016 Protocol (applicable from 2019-01-01 per map.json) only replaced Art. 26 (exchange of information) - no rate changes (Drucksache 18/11869). The UJP-hosted file (Germany.pdf) is the scanned Služben vesnik 86/2007 publication; the text-searchable German Bundestag version was used for quotes.
